requirements.clip: required WallTurn scrubbed once from 0 to 2pi
requirements.rendering: transparent direct Three.js, sRGB, AgX, DPR <= 1.5, no shadows or controls
requirements.motion: scroll-event RAF coalescing only; no autoplay, damping, accumulation, overshoot, or idle loop
requirements.fallback: poster on loading, reduced motion, load or clip failure, and context loss
requirements.accessibility: one semantic image; poster alt empty; canvas aria-hidden and untabbable
requirements.cleanup: listeners, RAF, observer, mixer, geometries, materials/textures, renderer
